newsitem.title: USA: W. Nebraska gets four-hour freeze Friday - WSC.
newsitem.headline: W. Nebraska gets four-hour freeze Friday - WSC.

text.p: Below freezing temperatures were recorded in the western third of Nebraska for four hours Friday morning, Weather Services Corp said.
"North Platte hit 31 degrees at 3 a.m. and stayed below freezing for four hours," said meteorologist Joel Burgio.
The average first freeze date for that region is Sept 23, he said. Last year, the first freezing temperatures came on Sept 22.
